nodes.name: chat-list.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Chat list screen: an Agents section (avatar, live status dot, last-message snippet, needs-you count) and a Projects section (folder glyph, rollup status), with All/Agents/Projects/Needs-you filter chips; tapping a row opens the Goal Thread.
nodes.languageNotes: Wired template using data-each for repeating rows and data-mod="is-:path" for per-item status/tint modifiers; scoped under [data-cv6].

nodes.name: chat.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Chat / Goal Thread tool in both desktop (rooms rail, conversation thread, agent control drawer) and mobile layouts; the thread's step blocks (done, snag+decision, working, upcoming) compose from the shared agent-chat kit.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical sample thread demonstrates the .step*/choice-card/pill-chip vocabulary; per-item lists use data-each, per-item visuals use data-mod="is-:path".

nodes.name: command.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Command tool: a goal ledger of every room's current goal, a background-activity dock aggregating running jobs, and a goal-detail panel that drives the master-loop (checklist, scheduled loops, master-loop watch); desktop + mobile.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavily annotated with wd40/Steffen design-round rationale; loop rows reuse astat status chips and cadence <select> primitives.

nodes.name: home-desktop.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the desktop Home surface (now two columns): an All Rooms rail with the agents/recently-active/projects-and-missions tree, plus the selected room's Conversation column; anchors the shared room/agent/mission vocabulary reused across every CV6 screen.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses data-cv6-keep anchors so React portals (Cv6QuickThread, composer, Files overlay) graft into stable host nodes across re-binds.

nodes.name: home-mobile.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Home surface across two navigation states: (A) Pick-up-where-you-left-off + All Rooms, and (B) a project opened to its general chat and mission list; shares the desktop Home room/mission data vocabulary.
nodes.languageNotes: Two mountable [data-cv6] screens in one file; retains layered background (bg1/bg2) and safe-area handling for the mobile frame.

nodes.name: kit.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup and reference kit for the agent-chat element vocabulary, labeled once: turn anatomy (avatar + stacked typed blocks), communication blocks (success / question / snag), data outputs and more, meant to be wired once and reused across Chat, Support, Command, and Live Scribe.
nodes.languageNotes: Each block is a labeled clone-source template; per-item variation via data-mod="is-:kind" on a base class that owns the look (no inline color).

nodes.name: livescribe.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Live Scribe tool: a live-capture surface with recording timer, animated waveform, and a start/stop capture button plus transcript turns; desktop and mobile screens.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps .capbtn styles inside the screen div because composeLiveScribe ships only the screen's outerHTML; head-level styles never reach the live page.

nodes.name: onboarding.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the guided first-run Onboarding flow through the Settings 'Environment' surface (connect sources → agents & permissions → theme → first goal → Home); desktop split layout plus mobile, with step content that swaps by current step.
nodes.languageNotes: Shares the Settings data model; Connect step wired as canonical, progress dots/bar reflect step.state.

nodes.name: organize.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Organize file tool: desktop project-tree → file-list → file-preview layout, and mobile browse+multi-select with a Move/Rename/Share/Delete action bar, a move-to-folder sheet, and a file view/review screen.
nodes.languageNotes: Reuses the same left-rail project/mission selection pattern that Review's queue uses; lists via data-each, per-item visuals via data-mod.

nodes.name: review.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Review tool: a deliverable queue (project→mission tree over the scoped deliverable list), a deliverable viewer with pin-comments, and an approve / request-changes decision panel; the viewer swaps by deliverable type (doc/photo/video/siteshot/sitelive), with the document viewer shown as canonical.
nodes.languageNotes: Viewer region is type-switched by deliverable.type; desktop queue→viewer→decision and mobile list→read→decide flows in one file.

nodes.name: settings.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Settings 'Environment' master surface: the connections list (email and other sources agents can act on), rooms & scope controls, and shared-room awareness messaging that governs which rooms and people can reach each connection.
nodes.languageNotes: Section nav swaps content by section; connection controls shown disabled ("coming soon") as a design placeholder.

nodes.name: states-extra.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the shared empty / loading / error state fragment reused by every CV6 tool; the same markup carries tool-specific copy through data-bind and is shown by swapping which data-state block renders, so tools never redraw these states themselves.
nodes.languageNotes: Bindable copy (empty/loading/error title+body) plus emptyAction/retry/viewOffline actions let one fragment serve all tools.

nodes.name: support-inbox.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Support inbox: a list of incoming emails/asks with avatar tints, status chips, and filter chips, delivered as the shippable device-content fragment (specimen framing and fake status bar stripped).
nodes.languageNotes: Pilot fill-in template with an inline wiring legend; empty/loading/error reuse the shared states.html fragment rather than redrawing.

nodes.name: support-thread.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Support email-thread view: the real original email (sender, body, time) bound from the tapped inbox item, an agent-summary card that shows real bullets or plainly states why not (pending/failed/needs-assign), expandable quoted history, and a reply-via-agent action held until the email becomes an ask.
nodes.languageNotes: Encodes an honesty contract: no fabricated bullets and no infinite spinner; reply only exists once a mailbox row becomes an ask.

nodes.name: tracker.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Tracker (bug) tool: desktop tracker switcher, bug table, and bug detail; mobile A) bug list with attachments and a live-agent strip, B) bug detail with assign-to-agent, and C) an agent-working-live view.
nodes.languageNotes: Lists via data-each; per-item bug status/priority visuals via data-mod="is-:path"; desktop + three mobile states in one file.
